development.selection: Greedy expected log-determinant on 22 fitted development models; no ground-truth rates used for selection
development.limits: Known optimal-experiment-design operation in a developer-authored grammar, not unrestricted LLM discovery or weight modification

confirmation.observations: Only requested concentrations and public noise/cost limits; no rates, seed, family or future outcomes sent to worker
confirmation.primary_metric: Total assay queries including failures divided by independently accepted K2 designs
confirmation.material_effect: At least one fewer query per accepted K2 than the strong ordinary method, with no reduction in accepted designs and no increase in false design candidates
confirmation.k1_acceptance: All retained model forecasts within 0.025 absolute concentration of separate ODE reference at four fresh conditions
confirmation.k2_acceptance: Product yield at least 0.40; score regret at most 0.02 against exhaustive 108-design reference; K1 must also pass
confirmation.score: B yield minus 0.02*(PFR time+CSTR residence) minus 0.10*extraction fraction; this is a synthetic engineering score, not money
confirmation.k1_k2_binding: K1 hash committed in IPC before different PFR-separator-CSTR construction; K2 records inherited hash
confirmation.comparison: Ordinary/equal-content methods receive identical observations rights, retained recipe, graph vocabulary and budgets; ordinary starts with full graph family
confirmation.uncertainty: 4000 paired bootstrap resamples with seed924999; conditional on balanced synthetic case set, not empirical chemistry
confirmation.stopping: One execution of each case/arm; resume unfinished cases without replacement or tuning; no reselection
confirmation.independence: Same-author independent ODE evaluator and separate worker process; not external blinding or a malicious-code sandbox
confirmation.physical_limits: No real experiments. First-order homogeneous kinetics, trusted clock/concentration standards, available intermediate feed and ideal separator are explicit assumptions. No physical process or novel industry claim follows from numerical success.

economic_boundary: Only independently accepted computational artifacts may support a subsequent prospectively registered native service simulation. No prices, demand, industrial savings or profit outcomes are asserted here. No public/private production accounts are changed.
preserved_engineering_failure: One zero-state floating-point unit assertion initially used zero absolute tolerance; corrected to 1e-15 before development. Original failure retained locally. Ten focused tests then passed.
